text: Janto an Muhammadu, tuma nde Men ɓorunoo fello ngol ɓe ɓamti ngo senngo dow ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen ɓaawo ɓe salaade Tawreeta. Fello ngon wonti wa duulere e ko'e maɓɓe, ɓe yananaa wonnde ngo yanay e maɓɓe. Ɓe wi'anaa : "Jogitoree ko Men okki on kon tiiɗnaare e pellital, jantoɗon ñaawooje mayre ɗe Alla sar'inani on ; belajo'o, on huliray ɗum Alla".
